1 Installation

# Install FLCore and ggplotFL from the FLR project repository
install.packages(c("FLCore", "ggplotFL"), repos = "http://flr-project.org/R")

# Alternatively, install the latest development versions from GitHub:
remotes::install_github("flr/FLCore")
remotes::install_github("flr/ggplotFL")
